name: starting architecture
last_analysis: All 9 trials scored 0 on dev, and training success was also 0. That held across recipes (1, 2 and 4 epochs; gamma 0.95 to 0.99; entropy 0.002 to 0.01), per-layer heads, attention, dihedral and fully connected heads that ignore the action frame, and mask input. So a mismatch between the obs frame and the action frame is unlikely to be the cause. A sound guess is that training collapses early. Random placements mostly fill cells outside the target, so they earn negative reward. DONE earns 0, so PPO may learn to quit at once or to make safe, timid moves before it finds the placement rule. The remaining bets aim at early-stage dynamics: stronger and longer exploration, standard PPO initialisation (an almost uniform starting policy and a well-scaled critic), and a separate critic so value learning does not distort the policy features.
